Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a matched-pair design with 4-plex iTRAQ labeling and DDA acquisition on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos. No PTM enrichment was performed; the study focused on global differential protein expression.

cell_lines: The human SqCLC cell line H226 and SK-MES-1 were purchased from ATCC and the Cell Bank of Type Culture Collection of Chinese Academy of Sciences (CBTCCCAS), respectively.
noncellular_sources: We analyzed primary tumor samples of 20 SqCLC patients using quantitative proteomics
Surgically-resected tumor tissues and adjacent normal tissues from cohort 1 were collected
scope: Tissues were homogenized in SDT lysis buffer (4% SDS, 0.1M Tris-HCl pH 7.6, 0.1M DTT) using a Tissue Lyser II (Qiagen).
A modified Filter Aided Sample Preparation (FASP) (compatible with iTRAQ labeling) was used for tissue digestion.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on homogenized tumor tissues using FASP, which is consistent with a whole cell lysate scope. While cell lines (H226, SK-MES-1) and mouse xenografts are mentioned, they were used for functional validation (Western blot, qPCR, growth assays) and not for the primary LC-MS/MS proteomics dataset (PXD009383).
